scenarios.last_reply: Hey there! 😊 I'm Sam from HDS Group. How can I help you today — looking for boards, pricing, or maybe a quote for a project?

scenarios.name: Branch lookup - Cape Town
scenarios.last_reply:
Hi there! 😊 So it looks like we don't have a branch listed specifically under "Cape Town" in our system right now. We do have branches in other major cities like Johannesburg, Pretoria, and Durban.

Could you let me know if you're open to checking a nearby branch, or if you'd like, I can also help sort out delivery of boards straight to your area from one of our other branches. What would work best for you?

scenarios.name: New customer greeting - casual
scenarios.last_reply:
Hey there! 👋 I'm Sam from HDS Group. Happy to help with info on our boards.

Are you working on a specific project — like kitchen cabinets, a wardrobe, or something else? And do you have a material or look in mind (like white melamine, wood grain, etc.) or would you like me to show you some options?

scenarios.name: Handover - large order triggers handover (>50 sheets)
scenarios.last_reply:
Hi Big Order Test! 👋 Thanks for reaching out - 80 sheets of white melamine is a great sized project. Since that's a bulk order, I'm looping in our sales team who can sort out the best bulk pricing for you directly. They'll be in touch shortly to get you the best deal! 🙌

In the meantime, if you'd like, I can show you our white melamine range so you can see the options while you wait. Just let me know!
